notes.title: Update Notes
notes.content: Improvements on the characters skills and game balance.

notes.title: Update Notes June
notes.content: Bug fix and a new enemy.

notes.title: NEW POWERS!
notes.content:
New powers are waiting for you!

Max out one or all your weapons and a mysterious God will send you help to face your enemies. You can enhance your attacks with fire, water, thunder and wind!

notes.title: New creature!
notes.content:
A new monster has arrived, the Satyr!

- There's a new enemy to fight in the heart of the forest!
The Satyr, who will play very dangerous music with his flute. Furthermore, the plants that will spawn at his feet will be very poisonous!

- Improved difficulty balance.

- More readable enemy impacts.

- Better visual feedback of the punches.
